title: Make the failing negative-amount test for FormatCents pass
requirement: The visible test TestFormatCentsNegative in inventory/money_negative_test.go fails: FormatCents renders negative amounts wrongly (for example -150 comes out as "-1.-50" instead of "-1.50"). Fix FormatCents in code so that every negative amount is rendered as a leading minus sign followed by the same digits as its absolute value, with two fraction digits. Do not change any test.
